description: derm policy gate. PreToolUse runs derm's gate (`derm hook claude-code pre`) and blocks when the hook fails or times out (onFailure block). PostToolUse redacts secret-like values in the result and records the call. Each runs /bin/sh by its absolute path in exec form (no shell, no PATH lookup) on hooks/derm-gate.sh, which runs derm from its install folders (contracts/hook-dialects.md 9.1; rules case 227).
